standard.summary: 降低原生 DiT LoRA 反传激活峰值。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.auto: Anima/Newbie 一类路线按需重算 LoRA 分支，压激活峰值。
optionDescriptions.on: 强制重算，激活省、反向慢。
optionDescriptions.off: 不重算，峰值高，好做对照。

standard_en.summary: Lowers the backward activation peak of native DiT LoRA.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.auto: On routes such as Anima/Newbie, recomputes the LoRA branch as needed to hold the activation peak down.
optionDescriptions.on: Always recomputes: less activation memory, slower backward.
optionDescriptions.off: Never recomputes: a higher peak, good as a control.

advanced.principle: 降低原生 DiT LoRA 反传激活峰值。auto 会在 Anima/Newbie 路线默认开启；off 主要用于 benchmark 对比。

advanced_en.principle: Reduces native DiT LoRA backward activation peaks. auto is on by default on the Anima/Newbie routes; off is mainly for benchmark comparisons.
